restrictions: This entry uses the exact two-round BLAKE3 55/63-byte non-root last-chunk half-collision construction from proof.md. The type-conditioned test-(2) DFA enforces f9 xor f10 = 1 and f24 xor f25 = 1 xor t, t = (Y4 bit4 xor Y4 bit5), with the two exact lists selected from the member type. Each list word is first tested by an exact packed Y9 prefilter (Lemma PF, 7 units: XOR, ADD, AND, ADD, AND, comparison and branch, each counted): enumeration of condition (1) over all 1024 low-10-bit prefixes leaves 14, all with Y9 bits {0,1,2,6,7,8,9} in {0x004, 0x3c4}, so words with no such lane skip E work losslessly. The word test of a kept word is three units (AND, comparison, branch) and the Y9 fill is 39 units.

The member class has 262144 members of each type. Exact E-word counts are 23820160 and 34028800 and each type has 4160 live low-half states; the online source builds both tables and checks these identities. Messages are distinct and the four fixed digest words are checked by the inherited construction. The selection call that fixes the advice record is the one pinned call of proof.md Section 12 (stated binary, seed, instance generator and replay record).

This is a credited derivative of the owner's c994a61f entry (57.1890), itself a derivative of the owner's 5f7e222e (57.2365); changes 1 to 10 are c994a61f's and changes 11 to 13 add the lists of the member's class, with the exact integer ledger, budgets, power certificate and memory in the first section of proof.md. N=62066075169728519695 and log2(N/430)=57.00224587, rounded up to 57.0023. E_KEPT=24345360 replaces E_COUNT in the E budget: E_BUDGET=6058029891640903525, PF_BUDGET=112442274923301272, WB=50046252029139831272; W_CTX=32833716. The build of the class lists is charged once, BUILD=834078790425024, and a member is 71 units. MU=0.004459 is re-declared from a preregistered run of 2^38 steps (mean plus six standard errors); the boundary 115, scan 12, context 436 and factor 0.974 are premises with their cited evidence.

Each member reads only the list words alive for its list class (type t and e1 bits 2, 26, 27; 16 classes of 32768 members). Aliveness of a typed word E for a member y: words g, h and an eps of S satisfy (J1) to (J3) of proof.md 9.4 with Q free (Lemma CP: the omega of a listed good trial is alive). The 16 lists come from an exact deterministic enumeration with one representative member per class (462791680 tests, kept counts summing to 389525760 = 16 * 24345360); every list equals its state's typed list cut by a 128-bit mask on bits 16 to 22 of omega, which the declared program carries and checks against the kept counts. That one member decides its class is the declared premise H_class.

heuristics.statement: The inherited listed-good-trial rate and context-level dependence premise of the fa97a08f construction, unchanged by the typed-list filtering, by the prefilter and by every change of this entry.
heuristics.scope: The same 55/63-byte, flags-3, non-root counter walk and exact solver construction, with the same run length and expected count 0.49594.
heuristics.extrapolation: The rate and dependence are inherited; typed lists, the prefilter and the class lists only remove words that cannot hold a listed good trial (the class lists under H_class), and no change of this entry alters which trials are searched.
heuristics.limitations: This remains a heuristic premise, not a theorem.

heuristics.statement: The E-lane and pass counts of the walk are at most 1.000051 and 1.001440 times their exact shares, E_KEPT/2^32 per step for a step whose omega is in the list of its member's class (E_KEPT = 24345360, the mean kept count of the 16 classes) and PASS_COUNT*E_COUNT/2^64 per step with PASS_COUNT = 14110208 and E_COUNT = 28924480 (the typed lists, a superset of the filtered walk's passing steps), plus a Hoeffding reserve over contexts.
heuristics.scope: All RUN_STEPS outer steps. The preregistered run of 2^38 steps measured 1.0000 of the plain pass share and 1.0156 of the live-block model share.
heuristics.extrapolation: The kept counts are exhaustive; the factors and the transfer of the sampler law to the run are inherited from the typed lists. A preregistered run of 2^19 contexts on the class lists measured the listed entries at 1.002164 (standard error 0.001978) of E_KEPT*2^19/2^32, which does not reject 1.000051 (mean minus 4.75 standard errors 0.992768) but cannot measure it to six digits.
heuristics.limitations: The sampler-law transfer remains heuristic. A factor that is too low can only halt the run (W reaches WB); the time bound is not affected.

heuristics.statement: The mean metered debit of the declared program per outer step (the screen's 64 + 20|T| plus the lane's 15 call-only units plus the executed solver ledger) is at most MU = 0.004459 machine units. MU is the measured mean of the preregistered run (2^38 uniform walk steps, all 2^19 contexts of fixed seeds, mean 0.0043854, standard error 1.220e-05) plus six standard errors, rounded up to four significant digits; the credit adds a Bernstein reserve and a preflight reserve.
heuristics.scope: The unchanged screen and capped solver on the class-list walk, over the 2^69.862 outer steps of the run.
heuristics.extrapolation: From 2^38 sampled steps (about 2^-31.9 of the run) to the run. The rule (mean plus six standard errors) was written before the run and the whole sample was used. No MU scaling and no H_HIT premise. The class lists only remove steps, each with debit 0, from the walk of that run, and MU is a mean over all outer steps, so it stays an upper bound.
heuristics.limitations: The debit has a heavy tail (solver calls are rare, one call can debit up to 23151 units), the standard error is a statistical margin and not a proof, the seeds are pseudorandom, and the true mean is not proved. The Bernstein reserve bounds the run total given the mean, not the mean.

heuristics.extrapolation: Typed lists have the same 4160 live low-half count in either type; the preregistered run measured 1.0156 live blocks per context against the model's 1.0156.

heuristics.statement: For a uniform context, (a) the expected number of list words the exact Y9 prefilter keeps is at most 0.11 times the expected number of list words, and (b) the expected number of listed entries is at least 0.99 times its exact value E_KEPT*2^19/2^32 = 2971.85 on the class lists.
heuristics.scope: The kept-word and kept-lane work budgets of the counter walk; it does not affect the rate, the walk or which trials are found.
heuristics.extrapolation: Uniform projections give 1-(1-2^-6)^7 = 0.1044. A preregistered run of 2^19 contexts (2^38 steps) on the class lists kept 0.104554 (standard error 0.000020; largest of 64 batches 0.104852) of 223,900,086 list words and listed 1.002164 (standard error 0.001978; lowest batch 0.978750) of the exact count; at 4.75 standard errors both parts hold. The budget 1/8 is 1.195 times the share.
heuristics.limitations: A premise on a work count, like H4' and H_G_cluster; if it failed the run would halt and only the success probability would fall.

heuristics.statement: For each of the 16 list classes (member type t and e1 bits 2, 26, 27) and each typed E word of its type, the word is alive for all 32,768 members of the class or for none, so the list built with the class's representative member is the list of every member (with Lemma CP, no listed good trial is skipped).
heuristics.scope: The 16 class lists of the counter walk; it bears on the success probability only, since the work of the walk is that of the stored lists.
heuristics.extrapolation: Evidence, with no disagreement found: 524,943,360 tests of a word against another member of its class; 32,000 complete groups of a word against all 32,768 members (1,048,576,000 evaluations); a single-bit influence test in which only bits of y that are constant on each class change a verdict; two of the fifteen free directions (bits 11 and 31 of y) proved; every constructed and planted true instance in the list of its class.
heuristics.limitations: Thirteen of the fifteen directions are not proved; an exhaustive check would cost about 2^63 word operations. If the premise failed, a member could miss listed good trials and the success probability would fall below the stated value.
